sourceChecks.note: Rado's exact live U.S. e-commerce route identifies R32280109 and EAN 7612819066196 as a new USD 1,400 Add to Cart offer. It independently publishes the rhodium-dial and black-rubber configuration, stainless-steel case and back, 41.5 x 11.7 mm geometry, 87 g configured weight, R292 quartz PreciDrive/HeavyDrive accuracy of -10/+10 seconds per year, 150 m resistance, sapphire, date, Super-LumiNova material and dual-colour nighttime emission, and a pin buckle. It does not publish lug-to-lug, lug width, a timed lume-performance result, or the strap-to-case mechanism. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

The exact-reference retailer publishes 47.7 mm lug-to-lug and a 20/21 mm strap-width record, but the same page carries an older conflicting 41 x 12.2 mm, 89.6 g, and 100 m specification set instead of Rado's current 41.5 x 11.7 mm, 87 g, and 150 m row. With no measurement date or protocol tying 47.7 mm to the current revised specification, neither dimension is promoted. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

This exact-reference retailer publishes 20 mm lug width but also retains the older 41 mm case description and supplies no Rado service-part or strap-fastener evidence. It cannot resolve the current geometry or factory attachment contract. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Rado's general manual independently states that its average quartz deviation should not exceed 15 seconds per month, but the exact product page's stronger -10/+10 seconds-per-year R292 claim controls this row. The manual does not identify the R32280109 strap fastener or exact case span. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

note: Keep as research-only. Direct primary review validates current Rado HyperChrome Quartz R32280109 on black rubber as a new, in-stock USD 1,400 U.S. offer with 41.5 x 11.7 mm geometry, 87 g configured mass, R292 PreciDrive/HeavyDrive accuracy of -10/+10 seconds per year, 150 m resistance, sapphire, and date. Rado describes Super-LumiNova colors and low-light legibility but supplies no repeatable performance grade; its pin buckle does not identify the case fastener. A narrow Perplexity pass found no exact service/parts interface record and rejected a 47.7 mm span plus 20/21 mm width because their retailer pages retain an older conflicting 41 x 12.2 mm, 89.6 g, 100 m specification set. Lug-to-lug, lug width, lume grade, and attachment type therefore remain null.
